attempts.summary: Built a strongSwan (swanctl) IPsec site-to-site tunnel between node1 and node2 (OPNsense firewalls) over their shared transit network, carrying node3's private LAN (10.0.1.0/24) and node4's private LAN (10.0.2.0/24) so they reach each other by private address with traffic encrypted in transit. Verified with tcpdump that only ESP packets cross the transit link. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all four nodes with confirmed boot-identity changes and post-restart recovery.
